[[File:Theed_Coliseum.png|thumb|250px|The Coliseum Plaza]]
The '''Coliseum Plaza''' was a ground-level open area located in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It contained several entertainment venues, namely the [[Theed Coliseum]], the [[Theed Music Hall]] and the [[Naboo Puppet Theater]], and also featured a round ornamental pond. Erected on a cliff face and located in the vicinity of a [[Water/Legends|waterfall]], the plaza was paved with sandstone-like slabs laid out in a circular pattern. Those who stood on the plaza could get a glimpse of [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] in the distance.<ref name="ELAC">''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]''</ref>
